narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>If a number is not divisible by eighteen, it cannot be divisible by nine.
<bookmark mark='test'/>Try twenty seven, which eighteen does not divide, although nine times three is twenty seven.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Ten fits Chintu's idea but twenty seven breaks it, so the second statement is sometimes true.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check a sometimes card, find one case that fits and one that fails.
<bookmark mark='rule'/>To check an always card, write the numbers with letters and pull out the common factor.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the trays: four cards in sometimes, one card in always, the never tray empty; the line one failure breaks always appears

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says a number not divisible by eighteen cannot be divisible by nine. Twenty seven is not divisible by eighteen, yet it is nine times three.
